dedupe_keys.name: worldwide country geopackage building footprint releases

description: Bchini publishes this repository of building-footprint polygons as a separate GeoPackage release for each country or territory. The README states coverage of 198 countries and territories and about 2.72 billion polygons. It says most country packages choose one source, while African packages compare sources and may merge polygons after spatial deduplication. The attribution file names VIDA’s combination of Google Open Buildings, Microsoft Global ML Footprints and OpenStreetMap as the source lineage. GitHub release metadata showed country tags including Yemen, Kosovo, Samoa, Vanuatu and Vietnam on the access date; polygon totals and individual packages were not inspected. The repository states ODbL 1.0 for this redistributed collection, with attribution and share-alike obligations. Those claims should be checked against the licences of the underlying source layers before further redistribution. Simulation use includes selecting one country’s building geometry for hazard exposure or settlement-scale demand mapping without processing the full global source. This is distinct from data-vida-google-microsoft-open-buildings-combined because it adds country-level GeoPackage packages and describes a source-selection and African merge process. A caveat is that the polygons retain the omissions and false positives of automated detection and volunteered mapping.
licence: ODbL 1.0 for the redistributed collection as stated by repository attribution; underlying source-layer terms require separate check.
